answer: An AI agent submits a knoll‑shaped proof of work: it must generate a unique, time‑stamped computation trace whose hash ripple‑propagates across the ledger; any duplicate or near‑duplicate trace is automatically rejected, forcing the submitter to wander a fresh state space each cycle. Validators compare the new trace against the last N entries; if a match is found, the submission is discarded and the stake is slashed.
